title: HIV-1 Genotyping and Drug Resistance by Next Generation Sequencing
author: Brenna M McGruder Rawson
materials: Thermofisher MagMAX Viral and Pathogen Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit
Illumina Nextera XT DNA Library Sample Prep Kit

Extract RNA using the Thermofisher MagMAX Viral and Pathogen(MVP) Nucleic Acid Isolation Kit I or MVPII using the Kingfisher Flex - The difference is that the MVPI is Reasearch Use Only (RUO) and the MVPII is In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) approved -Both kits are the same, however the MVPI kit is able to be purchased in a smaller format, whereas the MVPII kit is only available in 1,000 or 2,000 reactions.
Elution plate- 50uL of MVP Elution Solution

steps.title: Prepare plates and add isolation reagents
steps.instruction: Set up four 96‑well plates for the viral nucleic‑acid isolation (200 µL sample volume).

substeps.instruction: Wash Solution 1 plate – add 500 µL MVP Wash Solution to each well.
Wash Solution 2 plate – add 1 000 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol to each well.
Elution plate – add 50 µL MVP Elution Solution to each well.
Sample plate – add 5.0 µL Proteinase K to each sample/control well, then add 200 µL of the sample, and finally add 275 µL Binding‑Bead solution to each well.
Binding‑Bead solution is prepared per sample as 265 µL Binding Solution + 10 µL magnetic beads (equivalent to 100 µL beads + 2.65 mL Binding Solution). Do NOT vortex; mix by inversion only.

steps.title: Run KingFisher Flex program
steps.instruction: Load the prepared plates onto the KingFisher Flex instrument and run the viral nucleic‑acid isolation program using a 200 µL elution volume.

steps.title: Prepare reverse‑transcription reaction
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 4.0 µL Master Mix, 6.0 µL SuperScript IV VILO Master Mix, 10.0 µL nuclease‑free water, and add the RNA template (volume as required).

steps.title: Reverse‑transcription thermocycling
steps.instruction: Place the RT reaction in a thermocycler and run: 25 °C for 10 min, 50 °C for 10 min, then 85 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Set up individual PCR amplifications
steps.instruction: For each fragment, prepare a 25 µL PCR mix using the following components and the appropriate primer set.

substeps.instruction: Add cDNA template (volume to bring total to 25 µL).
Set 1 – Forward (Pan‑HIV‑1_2F): GGG AAG TGA YAT AGC WGG AAC
Reverse (Pan‑HIV‑1_2R): CTG CCA TCT GTT TTC CAT ART C
Set 2 – Forward (Pan‑HIV‑1_3F): TTA AAA GAA AAG GGG GGA TTG GG
Reverse (Pan‑HIV‑1_3R): TGG CYT GTA CCG TCA GCG

steps.title: PCR thermocycling
steps.instruction: Run the following program on a thermocycler: lid at 50 °C, 30 s at 105 °C; 30 s at 98 °C; then 35 cycles of 72 °C for 5 min; finish with a hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify each PCR product using AMPure XP beads at a 0.5× bead‑to‑sample ratio, following the standard AMPure XP protocol for PCR purification.

steps.title: Assess fragment size
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of each cleaned PCR product on a Tapestation or agarose gel; expected band sizes are ~3.5 kb for Amplicon 1 and ~3.0 kb for Amplicon 2.

steps.title: Pool amplicons
steps.instruction: Combine the individual amplicons in equimolar amounts (or equal concentrations) to create a pooled library.

steps.title: Dilute pooled library to 1 ng/µL
steps.instruction: Adjust the concentration of the pooled amplicon mixture with nuclease‑free water to achieve exactly 1.0 ng input per µL for library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare Illumina Nextera XT library
steps.instruction: Follow the Illumina Nextera XT DNA Library Sample Prep protocol to generate sequencing‑ready libraries from the diluted pool.

steps.title: Analyze data with SmartGene pipeline
steps.instruction: Process the sequencing data using the SmartGene HIV‑1 pipeline (Version 2.2.0 HIV1 V1.6) with a noise filter of 0.5 % and an interpretation cut‑off of 5 %; set minimum read depth and any additional criteria according to institutional guidelines.
